lines.text: [TIME LEFT: 04:15]

2.text: Two close-ups side by side: Bayu grinning, Arya calm.

lines.text: DUNGEON: THE PETROL QUEUE · Wait: 40 min · Boss: The heat
Nobody told me holidays had queues.
Regular or premium?
...Yes?

5.label: PANEL 10
5.text: A cloud of exhaust in Chloe's face.

lines.text: KOFF KOFF!!

5.label: PANEL 11
5.text: Jake pushes his dead scooter along the kerb, surfboard strapped on.

lines.text: I came here to surf, not to do cardio.

5.label: PANEL 12
5.text: Evening, both sunburnt on the villa steps.

lines.text: Day one. Zero beaches.
One petrol station. Twice.
DEBUFF · Sunburn LV.3

5.label: PANEL 13
5.text: Day two, 8:40 AM. A Canggu cafe. Chloe with an iced latte, defeated.

lines.text: Maybe we just... stay in the villa.
Then the street went quiet.

5.label: PANEL 14 · FULL PAGE
5.text: Slow motion. Arya on his olive Athena and Sekar on her pink Athena glide past. No sound. The latte doesn't even ripple.

lines.text: ...Did those just go past? I didn't hear a thing.
TING.
[SIGNAL DETECTED]

5.label: PANEL 15
5.text: Sekar glances back with a knowing smile.

lines.text: Ride Bali the quiet way.

5.label: PANEL 16
5.text: Chloe's phone on werigo.co (real site copy): Ride Bali the quiet way · Choose your bike and dates · Review your estimate · Confirm on WhatsApp · Ride out ready.

lines.text: Jake. Jake. Look at this.
We can rent the quiet ones. They bring them to us.
...I'm listening.

5.label: PANEL 17 · CLASS SELECT
5.text: The booking becomes a character-select screen.

lines.text: ! CLASS SELECT · Choose your ride for the island.
WEDISON ATHENA · YELLOW · Quiet · Compact · Easy to ride
This one. It's small, it's cute, and it's yellow. I'm done choosing.

5.label: PANEL 18
5.text: Jake and the navy EdPower, lightning aura.

lines.text: WEDISON EDPOWER · NAVY · Level requirement: AGE 25+
I'm 29. Finally, being old pays off.
[REQUIREMENT MET]

5.label: PANEL 19
5.text: The booking request: Athena yellow, EdPower navy, 7 days at the weekly rate, delivery to the villa in Canggu. "Weekly rate estimate. Final price confirmed on WhatsApp."

lines.text: Seven days. Let's actually have a holiday.

5.label: PANEL 20
5.text: WhatsApp with Werigo.

lines.text: Hi! Can we get 2 bikes for 7 days from tomorrow? We're staying in Canggu. My boyfriend wants the big one.
Hi Chloe! Both bikes are free. We'll bring them to your villa tomorrow at 9, charged and ready. Helmets and phone holders are included.
Do we need to find a charging station?
We'll show you tomorrow. Mostly you just charge at the villa while you sleep.
...While we SLEEP??

5.label: PANEL 21
5.text: They hand the petrol scooters back.

lines.text: No refund for petrol!
What petrol?

5.label: PANEL 22 · CLIFFHANGER
5.text: That night. Chloe in bed. A golden window appears above her phone, not on it.

lines.text: ! VISITOR DETECTED · Name: CHLOE · Pass: 7 DAYS · Activation: TOMORROW, 09:00
...What app is this?

5.label: PANEL 23
5.text: A rooftop in Canggu. The guild watches the pillar of light.

lines.text: It's her?! The sunburnt one?!
The island chose her.
So who's delivering tomorrow?
You are.
DOOOON.
VISITOR PASS · Activating...

5.label: Closing
5.text: To be continued... NEXT CHAPTER: CH.6 · THE HANDOVER. Which bike would you pick for your Bali trip?

6.label: COLD OPEN
6.text: Black.

lines.text: 18 May 2026. Singapore.

6.label: PANEL 1
6.text: A dark boardroom at the top of a tower, the city glowing far below. Two men sit at the far end of a long black table, lit from behind so their glasses flash white. PAK CHAN, mid 50s, the chairman, still as a statue. PAK REMY, 29, the youngest numbers man the Board has ever had, tablet glowing in front of him. At the near end, a young man with his back to us: ODY.

lines.text: Bali. No showroom. No network. No team.
You will build all of it.

6.label: PANEL 2
6.text: Close-up. Pak Remy slides the tablet across the table without looking up.

lines.text: The budget is fixed. It will not move.
So. What price are you suggesting?
For what?
For your survival.

6.label: PANEL 3
6.text: Pak Chan leans into the light for the first time. No smile.

lines.text: Fail, and you never sit at this table again.

6.label: PANEL 4
6.text: ODY's face for the first time. He is not scared. A small, stubborn smile.

lines.text: Then give me the island.
SYSTEM (gold, huge, only the reader sees it): [CONTRACT ACCEPTED] [HIDDEN CLASS: THE OPERATOR]

6.label: Title card
6.text: CHAPTER 6 · THE HANDOVER.

6.label: PANEL 5
6.text: Present day. Night. The Werigo shop in Canggu, shutters half down. Dewa walks Arya in.

lines.text: Present day. Werigo, Canggu. 10:48 PM.
Before you deliver to the Visitor, you report to the Operator.
I thought you were the guild master.
I run the guild. He runs the island.

6.label: PANEL 6
6.text: The back office. A desk buried under two laptops, three buzzing phones and sticky notes, a whiteboard map of Bali full of pins. Tiny quest windows float around the man at the desk, stacked like browser tabs.

lines.text: BZZT. BZZT. BZZT.
[ACTIVE QUESTS: 47]
PHONE (WhatsApp pop-up): Pak, any update on the payment? 🙏
ODY (on the phone, not looking up): Yes Pak, today. ...Probably.

6.label: PANEL 7
6.text: ODY looks up. Arya's System tries to read him and glitches.

lines.text: [PLAYER: ODY] [CLASS: THE OPERATOR] [RANK: ???] [ERROR: STATS TOO HIGH TO DISPLAY]
Question marks...?
You're the Silent Rider. Sit. The coffee's cold, sorry.

(a) May 2026. An empty building in Denpasar, bare concrete, wires hanging, one plastic chair. A storm of quest windows flies at ODY. SYSTEM: ! MAIN QUEST: BUILD WEDISON BALI · Sub-quests: 214. ODY: "...Two hundred and fourteen."
(b) Night. The first Wedison SuperCharge canopy. ODY plugs a gun into a bike. SFX: KLIK. CAPTION: "The first three stations. Denpasar. Sunset Road. Tohpati."
(c) A map of Bali from the sky. Three green points flare and lines of light race between them under the island. SYSTEM (world): [ISLAND NETWORK: ONLINE] [SYSTEM AWAKENING IN LINKED BIKES...]
ODY (voice-over): Every station I open is a gate. The night the first three opened, your Athena woke up.

6.label: PANEL 9
6.text: Back in the office. Arya, stunned.

lines.text: So the powers. The guild. Werigo...
Werigo is how the visitors get in. I built the Visitor Pass so tourists could ride Bali the quiet way.
Your Chloe just got one.

6.label: PANEL 10
6.text: ODY slides a delivery card across the desk: Chloe & Jake · 9:00 AM · yellow Athena · navy EdPower.

lines.text: Nine sharp. Eighty percent battery minimum. Two clean helmets each. Phone holder on. Full briefing. And show them how to charge at the villa.
Yes, boss.
Don't call me boss. My bosses are much scarier.

6.label: PANEL 11
6.text: 8:59 AM. The villa gate. Chloe with a coffee, listening for engines. Nothing.

lines.text: I'll hear them coming. Scooters are loud.

6.label: PANEL 12
6.text: Behind her, a polite knock. Arya and Komang are already there with a yellow Athena and a navy EdPower.

lines.text: TOK TOK.
How long have you been standing there?!
About a minute. They're quiet.

6.label: PANEL 13 · HANDOVER CHECKLIST
6.text: Four panels, each with a small green window.

lines.text: (a) Close-up of the dash: 94%. ARYA: "Delivered at 94. You'll never get one under 80." SYSTEM: [BATTERY ✓]
(b) Komang hands over two helmets each. KOMANG: "Two each. Cleaned this morning." SYSTEM: [HELMETS ✓]
(c) Komang clicks Chloe's phone into the holder. CHLOE: "Oh, that's clever." SYSTEM: [PHONE HOLDER ✓]
(d) The briefing. ARYA: "It's quiet, so people won't hear you. Tap the horn at corners. And keep left." JAKE: "Left. Left. Left." SYSTEM: [BRIEFING ✓]

6.label: PANEL 14 · HOME CHARGING
6.text: Arya lifts the Wedison charging adapter out of the bag: plug into a normal wall socket on the villa terrace, connector into the charging port on the LEFT side of the Athena's inner front panel, low under the handlebar. Jake's EdPower: the port on top of the centre tunnel in front of the seat.

lines.text: One end in the wall, one end in the bike. Plug in when you get home, like your phone. By breakfast it's full.
[NEW SKILL: OVERNIGHT CHARGE]
That's... it?
That's it. Normal socket. Anything happens, WhatsApp us, eight to eight. We come to you.

6.label: PANEL 15
6.text: The keys change hands. Two windows burst open, yellow for Chloe, navy for Jake.

lines.text: [VISITOR PASS ACTIVATED · 7 DAYS] [CLASS: WANDERER]
[VISITOR PASS ACTIVATED · 7 DAYS] [CLASS: TORQUE HUNTER]
Did your phone just...
Yours too?

6.label: PANEL 16 · FULL PAGE
6.text: Chloe's first ride on the yellow Athena through the Canggu rice fields, laughing, Jake beside her on the EdPower.

lines.text: VMMM...
I can hear the birds. On a scooter. I can hear the birds.

6.label: PANEL 17
6.text: Night. The dark villa courtyard, a small green charging light on each bike. Chloe and Jake asleep inside.

lines.text: While they slept, the bikes filled up.

6.label: PANEL 18 · CLIFFHANGER
6.text: The same night. The arrivals hall at the airport, almost empty. Two men walk out of the glass doors, suits dark, glasses flashing under the lights. Pak Chan. Pak Remy.

lines.text: SYSTEM (red, enormous): ! WORLD EVENT: THE AUDIT · The Board has landed.

6.label: PANEL 19
6.text: ODY's phone lights up on his desk. A voice message from Pak Chan.

lines.text: Seven days, ODY. Show me this island can stand on its own.
Or we switch it off. All of it.
[AUDIT: 7 DAYS] [FAIL CONDITION: THE GUILD IS DISBANDED]

6.label: PANEL 20
6.text: ODY stares at the screen, then at the whiteboard, then laughs once, tired.

lines.text: Seven days. Same as the visitors.

6.label: Closing
6.text: To be continued... NEXT CHAPTER: CH.7 · SEVEN DAYS. Would you survive an audit from Pak Remy? Tell us in the comments.

7.label: COLD OPEN
7.text: 5:58 AM. The Werigo shop, still dark. Komang unlocks the shutter, yawning, coffee in hand.

lines.text: Day 2. 5:58 AM.

7.label: PANEL 1
7.text: The shutter rises. Someone is already sitting inside in the dark, face lit only by a tablet. Rimless glasses flash. Pak Remy.

lines.text: KRRRRAK.
You open at eight.
...We open at eight?!

7.label: PANEL 2
7.text: Komang's coffee hits the floor.

lines.text: SPLAT.
[AUDIT: DAY 2 / 7]

7.label: PANEL 3
7.text: ODY arrives, still in yesterday's shirt, two phones in his hands.

lines.text: Your fleet is at ninety five percent. Why not one hundred?
Because we stop at ninety five. It keeps the batteries healthy for years.
...Noted.

7.label: Title card
7.text: CHAPTER 7 · SEVEN DAYS.

7.label: PANEL 4 · DAY 2, UBUD
7.text: Dawn. Chloe and Jake glide through a waking village. A grandmother sweeping, a rooster, offerings on a step. Nobody looks up.

lines.text: Day 2. Ubud.
Nobody even turns around. We're just part of the morning.
[VISITOR QUEST: SEE THE ISLAND · 2 / 7]

7.label: PANEL 5
7.text: Tegallalang rice terraces, full page. Chloe sketching on a bench, Jake taking photos, the two bikes parked on the lane.

lines.text: Battery?
More than half. We could go all the way back and do it again.

7.label: PANEL 6 · THE AUDITOR FOLLOWS
7.text: A black car idles on the road above the terraces. Pak Remy in the back seat, tablet up, filming them.

lines.text: They have not stopped once for fuel.
Numbers, Remy. Not stories.

7.label: PANEL 7 · DAY 3
7.text: Rain. A flat tyre near Tabanan. Chloe and Jake under a warung roof.

lines.text: Okay. This is where holidays go wrong.
WhatsApp them?

7.label: PANEL 8
7.text: Phone close-up, WhatsApp.

lines.text: Hi, flat tyre near Tabanan, sorry!!
No worries, share your location. Komang is on his way.

7.label: PANEL 9 · PATHFINDER
7.text: Komang on the red Victory tears through a narrow gang no map shows, orange light trail, chickens scattering.

lines.text: [PATHFINDER: SHORTCUT FOUND · ETA 11 MIN]
Every gang on the island, baby!

7.label: PANEL 10 · THE CHAIRMAN WATCHES
7.text: Across the road, a black car. The window slides down a few centimetres. Pak Chan watches Komang sort the tyre in under ten minutes. The window slides back up.

lines.text: [THE BOARD IS WATCHING]

7.label: PANEL 11
7.text: The warung owner brings hot tea. Chloe laughs, soaked.

lines.text: Tea while you wait.
Best bad day I've ever had.

7.label: PANEL 12 · THE HELMET TRIAL
7.text: The Werigo shop. Pak Remy walks the helmet shelf. The crew stands very straight.

lines.text: Two helmets per rider. One is cheaper.
Two is the standard. The second one is for the person they fall in love with on the trip.
...That is not a number.
Give it seven days.

7.label: PANEL 13 · DAY 4, ULUWATU
7.text: Sunset. The Wedison SuperCharge canopy on the cliff. Sekar and Dewa charging. Chloe and Jake pull in.

lines.text: Visitors, huh? How's the island treating you?
I haven't opened my laptop in four days.

7.label: PANEL 14
7.text: Dewa shows Jake the steps on the pile and the app.

lines.text: Gun in the port. Scan the QR on the pile with the Wedison SuperCharge app. Pay, and it starts by itself. Ten to eighty in about fifteen minutes.
You two are fine though. You charge at the villa every night.

7.label: PANEL 15 · BAYU
7.text: A loud engine dies right at the canopy entrance. Bayu, pushing his sportbike again.

lines.text: PUTT... PUTT... PFFT.
Don't. Say. Anything.
...Is he okay?
He's been "okay" since chapter two.

7.label: PANEL 16
7.text: From the edge of the car park, Pak Remy watches Dewa's app screen over his shoulder. For the first time, he stops typing.

lines.text: Fifteen minutes...

7.label: PANEL 17 · DAY 5
7.text: Dawn. Chloe and Jake stop respectfully for a temple procession, offerings on women's heads, the bikes silent at the roadside.

lines.text: Some mornings, you just pull over and watch.

7.label: PANEL 18 · MIDNIGHT
7.text: The Werigo shop. ODY alone at the whiteboard. A red window over his head.

lines.text: [AUDIT: 2 DAYS LEFT] [PROJECTED VERDICT: SHUT DOWN]
Numbers don't lie, ODY.
Numbers alone won't save us. Let them see who we ride for.

7.label: PANEL 19 · DAY 6
7.text: Seminyak at night. Street food, the bikes parked outside, fairy lights.

lines.text: Home, plug in, sleep. I'm going to miss this routine.

7.label: PANEL 20 · THE TWIST
7.text: Same night, 1 AM. An empty coastal road. A lone rider on a black Wedison Athena, helmet visor down, rimless glasses under it. Pak Remy, riding alone, testing it himself.

lines.text: Nobody was supposed to see this.
No vibration. No noise. No fuel receipt.

7.label: PANEL 21
7.text: A faint grey dashed window flickers beside him, then disappears.

lines.text: SYSTEM (grey, glitching): [PLAYER DETECT... ERROR]
...What was that?

7.label: PANEL 22
7.text: Last night at the villa. Charging lights glow in the courtyard. Chloe finishes her sketchbook. The cover reads THE QUIET WAY.

lines.text: Seven days. One sketchbook. I forgot I could do this.

7.label: PANEL 23 · DAY 7
7.text: Arya and Komang arrive for the pickup.

lines.text: Is it weird to be sad about a scooter?
Everyone says that.
Can we just... extend? Or come back?
Monthly is cheaper. Just saying.
Chloe. We have jobs.
For now.

7.label: PANEL 25
7.text: Their windows fade.

lines.text: [VISITOR PASS EXPIRED]
[RETURN QUEST UNLOCKED: COME BACK SOON]

7.label: PANEL 26 · CLIFFHANGER
7.text: The Werigo shop. The door opens. Pak Chan and Pak Remy walk in and sit down across from ODY. Nobody speaks. Pak Remy's helmet hair is still a little flat.

lines.text: SYSTEM (red, enormous): [AUDIT: DAY 7 / 7] [VERDICT PENDING]
Well, Operator?

7.label: Closing
7.text: To be continued... NEXT CHAPTER: CH.8 · THE VERDICT. Should the Board shut the island down? Vote in the comments.

8.label: PANEL 1
8.text: The Werigo shop, day 7, 10 AM (continues from CH.7). Pak Chan and Pak Remy on one side of the table, ODY alone on the other. The crew watches through the glass.

lines.text: Seven days. Fleet cost, charging, staff, helmets, one flat tyre.
What price are you suggesting for all of this?

8.label: PANEL 2
8.text: ODY doesn't open his laptop.

lines.text: I'm not going to show you a spreadsheet. I'm going to show you who we ride for.

8.label: PANEL 3
8.text: The door opens. Chloe and Jake walk in, helmets in hand, the yellow Athena and the navy EdPower parked outside the glass.

lines.text: Sorry, are we interrupting?
Rate it. One to ten.
Eleven. We never looked for a petrol station once.

8.label: PANEL 4
8.text: Chloe opens her sketchbook on the table: seven days in drawings.

lines.text: I started drawing again. I haven't drawn for fun in two years.
[VISITOR PASS: COMPLETE] [ISLAND BOND: MAX]
We're coming back in March. For a month.
And I want to know what it costs to buy one.

8.label: PANEL 5
8.text: Close-up. Pak Remy's pen moves. For the first time, he writes something down.

lines.text: ...Repeat customer. Monthly. A buyer.
[AUDIT RESULT UPDATING...]

8.label: PANEL 6
8.text: Pak Chan stands. His red aura fades to green.

lines.text: The island stays.
SYSTEM (green, huge): [AUDIT PASSED] [THE GUILD SURVIVES]

8.label: PANEL 7
8.text: Behind the glass, Komang explodes. Dewa clamps a hand over his mouth.

lines.text: YESSS!!
Quiet.

8.label: PANEL 8
8.text: Chloe tears a page from her sketchbook for Arya: Arya riding in the rain.

lines.text: For the guy who delivered our holiday.

8.label: PANEL 9 · THE TWIST
8.text: Pak Chan at the door, not turning around.

lines.text: But the island does not run on one man. So I brought you another one.

8.label: PANEL 10 · SPLASH
8.text: The door swings open. A man in a tight pastel polo steps in with a golden aura blazing behind him like a raid boss.

lines.text: SYSTEM (gold, flickering): [NEW PARTY MEMBER] [YOKO · SENIOR OPERATIONS ADVISOR] [EXPERIENCE: "TWENTY YEARS" (SELF-DECLARED)] [RANK: ???]
Relax, bro. I've been doing this since you were in school.

8.label: PANEL 11
8.text: Pak Chan leaves.

lines.text: Yoko reports to me. Thirty days. Then I decide who runs Bali.
...Of course.

8.label: PANEL 11B
8.text: Yoko's eyes slide to the green OPERATOR lanyard on ODY's chest. A hidden window only the reader can see. Title card: CH.8 · THE VERDICT

lines.text: SYSTEM (purple, hidden): [HIDDEN QUEST: TAKE THE OPERATOR'S SEAT]
Jakarta boy. Two years on the island and they give him Bali? Thirty days. That seat is mine.

8.label: PANEL 12
8.text: DAY 1, 8:00 AM. Komang sets the morning canang sari at the shop door and lights the incense.

lines.text: In Bali there are two worlds. Sekala, the one you can see. Niskala, the one you can't.
The System lives in the second one. And it remembers everything.

8.label: PANEL 13
8.text: 11:40 AM. Yoko arrives and nudges the canang aside with his loafer. Komang freezes.

lines.text: You just kicked today's offering.
It's a leaf, relax.
SYSTEM (grey, faint): [NISKALA: RECORDED]

8.label: PANEL 14
8.text: Yoko takes the only good chair, feet on the desk, AC on full, iced coffee.

lines.text: I'm strategizing.
[QUEST LOG: EMPTY] [STATUS: "STRATEGIZING"]

8.label: PANEL 15
8.text: Yoko on the phone. ODY stands behind the half-open door, hearing everything.

lines.text: Honestly, Pak? ODY's too soft with the tourists. Numbers are... worrying. Give me Bali, Pak. I'll run it properly.

8.label: PANEL 16 · MONTAGE: THE WHISPERS
8.text: Yoko at a charging site with a landlord, laughing too loud.

lines.text: ODY? Nice guy. Jakarta boy. Doesn't understand Bali like we do.
Between us, the rental thing is his hobby.
WHATSAPP (crew group, from Yoko): "Guys, from today all SOPs go through me 🙏"

8.label: PANEL 17
8.text: Yoko prints ODY's weekly report and covers it in red pen.

lines.text: Amateur. Font too small. Numbers too honest.
Numbers can be too honest?
Only for him.

8.label: PANEL 18
8.text: Board video call. Yoko presents a deck: "ECOSYSTEM 360°", slide 47 of 60, a stock photo of a handshake.

lines.text: Synergy, Pak. Holistic. Three-sixty.
What price are you suggesting?
...Price is a mindset, Pak.

8.label: PANEL 19
8.text: Night, rain. Arya hands keys to a family at a villa gate for a monthly rental, olive Athena between them.

lines.text: [QUEST COMPLETE: MONTHLY RENTAL · ARYA]

8.label: PANEL 20
8.text: Yoko in the dry shop, posting Arya's photo to the Board chat.

lines.text: "Closed a monthly today. Leadership 💪"
[TRANSFER CREDIT: ARYA → YOKO?] [ERROR] [CREDIT CANNOT BE TRANSFERRED]

8.label: PANEL 20B
8.text: Night. The shop is empty. Yoko sits in ODY's chair, wearing ODY's OPERATOR lanyard, practising in the dark window reflection.

lines.text: Good morning, team. I'm your Operator now. ...No. Bigger. I AM THE OPERATOR.
[HIDDEN QUEST PROGRESS: 40%]
Outside the glass, unseen, Komang holding two late-night coffees. His jaw drops.

8.label: PANEL 21 · WIDE
8.text: DAY 15. The whole fleet lined up in front of the shop, every bike wearing a round woven palm-leaf tamiang on its handlebar. A pemangku in white sprinkles holy water. The crew in temple dress, udeng and kamen.

lines.text: Tumpek Landep. The day Bali blesses everything made of metal. Tools, keris, cars. And bikes.

8.label: PANEL 22 · VFX
8.text: The drops of tirta hit the bikes and turn into light. Every headlamp flickers on by itself.

lines.text: [BLESSING RECEIVED] [FLEET: PROTECTED]
...Did the bikes just light up?
Every year.

8.label: PANEL 23
8.text: The grandmother from CH.2 now makes the shop's offerings. Yoko, in a polo, filming for social media.

lines.text: They're blessing scooters, Pak. So cute.
Karma phala, nak. What you plant, you will eat.
[KARMA PHALA · ACTIVE]

8.label: PANEL 24 · STORY
8.text: That night, in the style of a Kamasan painting. The grandmother tells Arya and Komang an old story.

lines.text: Two farmers shared one subak. One opened the water every dawn. The other told the whole village how hard he worked.
At harvest the gods did not count words. They counted rice.

8.label: PANEL 25
8.text: DAY 24. Arya comes back soaked from a delivery, arms full of helmets. Customers in the shop. Yoko, loud.

lines.text: Look at him. A delivery boy. You're nobody, Arya.
In ten years you'll still be carrying helmets for tourists. People like you don't get opinions.

8.label: PANEL 26
8.text: Komang lunges. Dewa holds him back with one arm.

lines.text: SAY THAT AGAIN!
Not here.

8.label: PANEL 27 · VFX
8.text: Arya walks out into the rain. His status window cracks like glass.

lines.text: SYSTEM (grey, shattering): [ARYA · MORALE 12%]

8.label: PANEL 28
8.text: Night, the beach. Arya sits in the sand beside his olive Athena.

lines.text: He's not wrong. A year ago I was nobody.

8.label: PANEL 29
8.text: Two headlights. Sekar on the pink Athena, Komang on the red Victory.

lines.text: You were nobody. Then you rode forty medical kits through a storm. Nobody doesn't do that.
You didn't leave me in the flood, bro. I'm not leaving you on a beach.

8.label: PANEL 30
8.text: DAY 30. The bypass, midday heat. Yoko pushes his petrol maxi scooter, dry tank, loafers melting. Beside him, pushing his sportbike: Bayu. They look at each other.

lines.text: ...You too?
Don't.

8.label: PANEL 31
8.text: The shop. The Board is already seated. Yoko bursts in 40 minutes late, sweating.

lines.text: Pak! Traffic, ceremony, crazy day. Anyway: thirty days of transformation.
Sit down.

8.label: PANEL 32 · SKILL
8.text: Pak Remy takes off his glasses. His eyes glow blue.

lines.text: APPRAISAL.

[APPRAISAL: YOKO] [QUESTS COMPLETED IN 30 DAYS: 0] [DELIVERIES: 0] [PARTNERS SIGNED: 0] [HOURS IN THE AC CHAIR: 212] [TIMES HE SAID "ODY IS THE PROBLEM": 47] [HIDDEN QUEST: TAKE THE OPERATOR'S SEAT · FAILED] [REAL RANK: E]
Arya. 212 deliveries. Zero complaints. The monthly you posted? He closed it. In the rain.
And these. Nine messages asking the Chairman for ODY's job. While ODY was out opening gates.
And he practises in the window at night. "I AM THE OPERATOR."
Pak, the system is wrong...

8.label: PANEL 34
8.text: Pak Chan, red aura, glasses flashing.

lines.text: The system is never wrong. You were.
I brought you. That makes you my mistake. I don't keep mistakes.

8.label: PANEL 35 · VFX
8.text: Yoko's golden aura cracks and falls off him like broken glass. Underneath, a small tired man.

lines.text: [ILLUSION BROKEN] [KARMA PHALA · RESOLVED]

8.label: PANEL 36
8.text: Yoko leaves. At the door, for the first time, he steps around the canang.

8.label: PANEL 37
8.text: Pak Chan to ODY, still not smiling.

lines.text: The island does not run on one man. I was right about that.
I was wrong about the man. Find the one who actually carried it.
I know where he is.

8.label: PANEL 38 · WIDE
8.text: Dawn at Arya's banjar. Men weave a tall bamboo penjor for the temple anniversary. Arya among them in his udeng, hands full of palm leaf. ODY walks in.

lines.text: In my village we call this ngayah. You work because the village needs it. Not because someone's watching.
That's exactly why they want you.
Squad Leader. Your own crew.
He said I'm nobody.
He also said he had twenty years of experience. Remy checked. Eight months.

8.label: PANEL 40 · CLASS CHANGE SPLASH
8.text: Arya beside the olive Athena, blue lightning, the penjor behind him like a banner.

lines.text: SYSTEM (blue, enormous): [CLASS CHANGE] [SILENT RIDER → SQUAD LEADER]
[NEW SKILL: RALLY · Every rider who rides with you rides better]
[GUILD FUNCTION UNLOCKED: RECRUITMENT]

8.label: PANEL 41
8.text: Arya and Komang pin a poster on the banjar notice board.

lines.text: WERIGO IS RECRUITING. RIDERS WHO SHOW UP.
So... who do we recruit first?

8.label: PANEL 42 · CLIFFHANGER
8.text: Five silhouettes walk toward them out of the morning light.

lines.text: [RECRUITMENT QUEST: BUILD YOUR SQUAD · 0 / 5]

8.label: Closing
8.text: To be continued... NEXT CHAPTER: CH.9 · THE RECRUITS. Who should join Arya's squad first? Tell us in the comments.

9.label: PANEL 1
9.text: Night. The top floor of a glass tower in Jakarta. A foreign EV giant's office: a faceless CEO silhouette in a high-backed chair, red city lights. Yoko sits across, sweating, grinning.

lines.text: You worked inside their guild.
Thirty days. I know every weakness they have.

9.label: PANEL 2
9.text: A red contract glows on the desk. Yoko signs. Title card: CH.9 · THE RECRUITS

lines.text: Then bring me their people. Every rider they recruit, you buy.
[CONTRACT SIGNED] [NEW CLASS: TURNCOAT] [QUEST: EMPTY THE GUILD]

9.label: PANEL 3
9.text: Morning, the banjar hall. A trestle table with a basket of croissants and sourdough, Komang already eating one.

lines.text: If nobody comes, at least we have croissants.

9.label: PANEL 4
9.text: Nobody comes. One hour. Two. Komang eats his third croissant.

lines.text: [RECRUITMENT QUEST: 0 / 5]

9.label: PANEL 5 · SPLASH
9.text: Five people walk in at once: Putu with paint on his hands, Ayu in dance costume, Ketut smelling of the sea, Made on a coughing petrol bike, Kadek silent with a toolbox.

lines.text: ...Five.
(mouth full) Five!

9.label: PANEL 6 · RALLY
9.text: Arya activates his new skill. Five blue windows open over the five heads.

lines.text: [PUTU · ARTISAN] [AYU · SPOTLIGHT] [KETUT · TIDECALLER] [MADE · IRONWILL] [KADEK · ??? UNREADABLE]
The System can't read him?

9.label: PANEL 7
9.text: Arya's rules on a whiteboard, pinned beside the WERIGO poster: battery over 80% at every handover, two clean helmets, phone holder installed, charging briefing, smile.

lines.text: One day. Real jobs. Real guests.

9.label: PANEL 8 · AYU
9.text: A villa in Canggu. Ayu gives the charging briefing to a Korean family in fluent Korean, then French to the neighbours.

lines.text: [SPOTLIGHT: GUEST TRUST +40]

9.label: PANEL 9 · KETUT
9.text: Midday sun. Ketut stops the squad and looks at the sky.

lines.text: Rain in forty minutes. Take the inland road.
[TIDECALLER: STORM PREDICTED · 40 MIN]
(Forty minutes later the squad is dry under a warung roof as the sky opens.)

9.label: PANEL 10
9.text: Break under the warung roof. Sekar eats a browkies from a paper bag.

lines.text: Don't tell Dewa I'm sharing.

9.label: PANEL 11 · PUTU
9.text: Putu repaints a scratched helmet into a work of art. The guest wants to buy it.

lines.text: [ARTISAN: ITEM UPGRADED]

9.label: PANEL 12 · KADEK
9.text: A bike in the line-up. Kadek lays his palm on the battery case, frowns, points at the charging port. Dewa checks: a loose connector nobody else noticed.

lines.text: ...How did you know?
KADEK (signs, subtitled): It told me.
[KADEK · ??? ] [SKILL DETECTED: ???]

9.label: PANEL 13 · MADE
9.text: Made on a borrowed Wedison for the day: ten deliveries, no petrol stop, and he's home in time to pick up his kids.

lines.text: I didn't pay for fuel today. First time in eight years.
[IRONWILL: 10 / 10]

9.label: PANEL 14
9.text: That night, five doors. At each one, a man in loafers holding a fat envelope.

lines.text: Double salary. A foreign company. No more helmets for tourists.

9.label: PANEL 15 · MONTAGE
9.text: Putu staring at the envelope beside an unfinished ogoh-ogoh. Ayu at the dressing mirror. Ketut on his father's leaking boat. Made at the kitchen table with a pile of bills and two sleeping kids.

lines.text: SYSTEM (red, over each): [TEMPTATION]

9.label: PANEL 16
9.text: Next morning, the banjar. Empty. Five chairs.

lines.text: [RECRUITMENT QUEST: 0 / 5]
He bought them. Yoko bought all of them.

9.label: PANEL 17
9.text: Arya looks at the empty chairs.

lines.text: No. We go to them.

9.label: PANEL 18
9.text: Putu's banjar workshop. A half-built ogoh-ogoh demon, three metres tall.

lines.text: The money would finish my ogoh-ogoh.
Then the whole banjar parades something you sold yourself for. Is that the demon you want to burn?
(Putu tears the envelope in half.)

9.label: PANEL 19
9.text: Uluwatu at sunset. Ayu in the kecak circle, the chanting "cak-cak-cak" rising, the fire behind her.

lines.text: In kecak, nobody dances alone. Seventy voices keep one story alive.
His money wanted me to dance alone.

9.label: PANEL 20
9.text: Jimbaran. Ketut and his father patching the boat.

lines.text: The sea pays late but it pays honest. Go with the one who asked you first.

9.label: PANEL 21
9.text: Made's kitchen. The envelope is still sealed on the table, next to the bills.

lines.text: I didn't open it. I just... didn't know how to say no to money.
You said it yesterday, ten times. On ten deliveries. No petrol.

9.label: PANEL 22
9.text: The mechanic's garage. Kadek is fixing a neighbour's bike. The envelope is on the floor, stepped on, unopened. Yoko's pitch was all words.

lines.text: ...He never heard a word Yoko said.
KADEK (signs, subtitled): Who?
(Komang laughs so hard he cries.)

9.label: PANEL 23
9.text: Yoko, outside in the rain, envelopes soaked, phone ringing: the CEO.

lines.text: [QUEST FAILED: EMPTY THE GUILD] [TURNCOAT · REPUTATION -50]
...Next time.

9.label: PANEL 24
9.text: The banjar, morning. Five chairs, five people. Dewa hands out sourdough for breakfast.

lines.text: Squad Leader. Your squad.

9.label: PANEL 25 · SPLASH, VFX
9.text: Sunset ride along the coast: Arya in front on the olive Athena, five recruits on five Wedison bikes behind him. Blue light lines connect all six riders into a glowing emblem in the sky.

lines.text: SYSTEM (blue, enormous): [RALLY · FULL SQUAD] [RECRUITMENT QUEST: 5 / 5] [SQUAD REGISTERED: ARYA'S SQUAD]

9.label: PANEL 26
9.text: The windows flicker. A new window, gold and ancient, opens over all of them.

lines.text: [NOTICE: A HIGHER AUTHORITY HAS OBSERVED THIS SQUAD]

9.label: PART 7 · THE FIRST PLAYER (the mind-blowing ending)
PANEL 27
9.text: Evening. Arya brings a box of donuts (Jose Bakery logo on the box) to the grandmother from CH.2 to say thank you for the blessing. She is making canang on her porch.

lines.text: Nenek, your blessing worked. I have a squad now. Five.
Five is a good number, nak. In my time, we were five too.
...Your time?

9.label: PANEL 29 · FLASHBACK, sepia
9.text: 1963. Five young Balinese riders on old bicycles and a motorbike on an empty dirt road, a volcano smoking in the distance. Above each of them, the same blue System windows. In front, a young woman with a frangipani in her hair.

9.label: PANEL 30 · REVEAL, full page
9.text: The present. The grandmother looks up. Her eyes glow gold. Behind her, a colossal golden window unfolds across the night sky.

lines.text: SYSTEM (gold, enormous): [GATEKEEPER · RANK S] [THE FIRST PLAYER OF THE ISLAND] [ACTIVE SINCE 1963]
The System is not new, nak. Only the bikes are.
Your Operator thinks he opens the gates. The island only lends them.

9.label: PANEL 32 · CLIFFHANGER
9.text: Far away, a private jet lands at night. An old man in a golf polo steps down, followed by Pak Chan carrying his golf bag.

lines.text: SYSTEM (unreadable, static): [PLAYER: ???] [RANK: ???]
PAK CHAN (phone, to ODY): He's early. Three days. Don't be late.

9.label: Closing
9.text: To be continued... NEXT CHAPTER: CH.10 · THE OWNER. Which recruit is your favourite? Tell us in the comments.

10.label: PART 1 · THE DARK GATE (cold open, flash-forward)
PANEL 1
10.text: Night on the Bukit. A lonely Wedison SuperCharge pile beside a foggy road, frangipani trees and an old setra (cemetery) behind a low wall. The pile screen flickers and dies.

lines.text: SYSTEM (grey, glitching): [GATE 07 · OFFLINE]

10.label: PANEL 2
10.text: ODY's phone: the gate map of Bali. Green dots turning red, one after another.

lines.text: [GATE 08 · OFFLINE] [GATE 09 · OFFLINE]

10.label: PANEL 3
10.text: In the fog, a figure in white stands beside the dead pile, its back to us. Faint gamelan in the dark. ODY's torch shakes. PAK CHAN hides behind PAK LIAM. Title card: CH.10 · THE OWNER

lines.text: ...ding... dung...
Pak Liam, please... stay behind me.
Forty-eight hours earlier.

10.label: PANEL 4
10.text: 05:30. A clifftop golf course above the ocean, first light. Pak Liam drives a perfect ball. ODY, half asleep, carries the golf bag. Pak Chan holds an umbrella over Pak Liam. It is not raining.

lines.text: ...It's not raining, Pak.
The sun is also weather, Ody.

10.label: PANEL 5
10.text: The System tries to read Pak Liam and breaks.

lines.text: [PLAYER: ???] [RANK: ???] [LEVEL: ERROR]
Even the System is scared of him.

10.label: PANEL 6
10.text: Between swings, without looking up.

lines.text: How many ojol drivers ride in Denpasar every day?
...A lot?
[OWNER'S TEST · WRONG ANSWER]
What does one of them spend on petrol in a day?
It depends on...
Not enough.
[OWNER'S TEST · 0 / 3]

10.label: PANEL 8 · COMEDY
10.text: Pak Chan laughs loudly. Pak Liam stares at him.

lines.text: HA HA HA, very good, Pak!
I haven't finished the joke.
[PAK CHAN · FEAR +300]

10.label: PANEL 9
10.text: ODY holds up a tablet with his deck. Pak Liam pushes it down with one finger.

lines.text: Where do the next twenty gates go?
No slides. Slides don't ride.

10.label: PANEL 10
10.text: At the golf buggy, Pak Liam takes a slice of sourdough from a paper bakery bag.

lines.text: Sourdough. No butter. Tomorrow, you show me the street. Not the office.
If he leaves unhappy, I leave with him. And you leave before me.

10.label: PANEL 11
10.text: Morning. An ojol base under a giant banyan tree in Denpasar: drivers in plain jackets, petrol bikes, kopi in glasses. A black car stops. Pak Liam steps out in his polo and cap. Pak Chan follows in a full navy suit, already sweating. Arya and Komang wait on the olive Athena and the red Victory.

lines.text: DAY 2 · THE STREET
Who's the grandpa?
The System just says... question marks.

10.label: PANEL 13
10.text: Pak Liam sits on a tiny plastic stool among the drivers, a glass of kopi in his hand. Made (IRONWILL, from CH.9) sits next to him.

lines.text: What does your bike cost you every day?
Petrol, forty, fifty thousand. Oil. Chain. Something breaks every month.
The day I rode a Wedison, I paid nothing for fuel. I charged at home, at night.
And if the battery dies in the middle of an order?

10.label: PANEL 15
10.text: ODY shows the gate map on his phone.

lines.text: SuperCharge. Ten to eighty percent in about fifteen minutes. Open twenty-four hours.
Where?
(looking at the map) Not enough of them.
...Not yet.

10.label: PANEL 16 · COMEDY
10.text: Pak Chan tries to sit on a plastic stool in his suit. KRAK. The drivers roar. Pak Liam laughs for the first time.

lines.text: KRAK!
[PAK CHAN · DIGNITY -50]

10.label: PANEL 17
10.text: Pak Liam writes in a small notebook. He closes it.

lines.text: They know more than your deck.

10.label: PANEL 18
10.text: 23:40. ODY's phone lights up in the dark hotel room.

lines.text: [WARNING: GATE 07 OFFLINE]

10.label: PANEL 19
10.text: The car on a black road across the Bukit. ODY drives. Pak Liam in front, calm. Pak Chan in the back seat, clutching the headrest.

lines.text: Pak, we can send a technician tomorrow morn...
Tonight. The gate is ours. We go.

10.label: PANEL 20
10.text: They arrive. Fog, frangipani trees, the low wall of the setra, the split gate of an old temple in the mist. The pile is dark.

lines.text: ...ding... dung...

10.label: PANEL 21 · HORROR
10.text: A figure in white with a grey bun stands beside the pile, back turned, incense smoke curling around her. Pak Chan grabs Pak Liam's arm with both hands.

lines.text: ...Pak. Pak. PAK.

10.label: PANEL 22
10.text: She turns. It is the grandmother, the GATEKEEPER from CH.9. Her eyes glow gold. She holds an offering tray. Pak Chan's soul (tiny, comic) floats out of his mouth.

lines.text: [GATEKEEPER · RANK S]

10.label: PANEL 23
10.text: Around them, in the fog, faint golden shapes of the island's ancestors watch in silence. Peaceful, not evil.

lines.text: You built a gate on land that has owners you cannot see, nak. You forgot to ask.
...Nobody told us.
Sekala, you ask the landlord. Niskala, you ask the land.

10.label: PANEL 24
10.text: Pak Liam takes a stick of incense and kneels to place the offering beside the pile.

lines.text: In Hong Kong, we also ask the land before we build.

10.label: PANEL 25 · VFX
10.text: Two unreadable players face each other. His window of static and her ancient gold window touch, and sparks fly.

lines.text: [??? · MEETS · GATEKEEPER]
(smiling) This one is old too.
Not as old as you, madam.

10.label: PANEL 26
10.text: Arya and Kadek arrive on the olive Athena, headlight cutting the fog. Kadek lays his palm on the pile, then points at its base.

lines.text: [KADEK · ???] [SABOTAGE DETECTED]

10.label: PANEL 27
10.text: ODY opens the base cover: the power cable is cut clean.

lines.text: This wasn't the spirits.

10.label: PANEL 28
10.text: Torchlight on the mud: the print of a loafer. Next to it, an iced coffee cup with a straw.

lines.text: Who wears loafers to a cemetery?
(Nobody answers. Everybody knows.)

10.label: PANEL 29 · SPLASH, VFX
10.text: Kadek and ODY splice the cable. The pile screen glows green. A pillar of green light rises from the gate into the sky, and the ancestral shapes bow and fade. On ODY's phone, the red dots turn green one by one.

lines.text: [GATE 07 · ONLINE] [BLESSED BY THE LAND]

10.label: PANEL 30
10.text: Morning. No deck. ODY rolls up on a grey EdPower with a second one, black, beside it.

lines.text: Where is your presentation?
Today, you are the presentation. Get on.
(Pak Chan chokes on his coffee.)

10.label: PANEL 31
10.text: Pak Liam on the black EdPower, helmet on. He twists the throttle. No sound. Instant torque. His eyes go wide.

lines.text: [INSTANT TORQUE]
PAK! SLOWER!

10.label: PANEL 32
10.text: Riding side by side through Denpasar, past a long petrol queue. Pak Liam looks at the queue as they glide by.

10.label: PANEL 33
10.text: A SuperCharge station, close-up. ODY plugs the gun into the port on the EdPower's centre tunnel, in front of the seat (drawn from the real port reference). Behind him, Pak Liam scans the QR on the pile screen with his own phone and pays with QRIS.

lines.text: [SUPERCHARGE · 10% TO 80% IN ABOUT 15 MIN · OPEN 24 HOURS]
Plug, scan, pay. It stops at ninety-five to protect the battery.

10.label: PANEL 34
10.text: Back at the banyan tree. This time the drivers talk first, and ODY answers every question from the green.

lines.text: The station by the market is full every night.
The gates by the market fill up every night. That's where gate twenty-one goes. And the next twenty follow the drivers, not the map.
[OWNER'S TEST · 3 / 3]

10.label: PANEL 35
10.text: Pak Liam walks away with Pak Chan, not looking back.

lines.text: He will do.

10.label: PANEL 36 · SPLASH, VFX
10.text: A colossal white-gold window opens across the sky over Denpasar, and for the first time the System can read him.

lines.text: SYSTEM (white gold, enormous): [SOVEREIGN'S APPROVAL] [PLAYER: LIAM · RANK: SOVEREIGN] [OPERATOR · LEVEL UP]

10.label: PANEL 37 · COMEDY
10.text: Pak Chan exhales for the first time in three days and slides down the car door.

lines.text: Are you okay, Pak?
...Never tell anyone about the stool.

10.label: PANEL 38
10.text: The private jet at dawn. Pak Liam hands ODY a golf ball.

lines.text: Next time, you don't carry the bag. You play.
I don't play golf.
You will.

10.label: PANEL 39 · CLIFFHANGER
10.text: A dark room. Muddy loafers on a desk. Yoko on the phone, a map of Bali on the wall with a hundred red pins.

lines.text: And the gates?
That was one. Next time, all hundred of them.
[TURNCOAT · NEW QUEST: THE BACKDROP WAR]

10.label: Closing
10.text: To be continued... NEXT CHAPTER: CH.11 · THE BACKDROP WAR. Would you pass Pak Liam's test? Tell us in the comments.

11.label: PANEL 1 · SPLASH
11.text: Night, the whole island of Bali seen from high above. One hundred faint pillars of light are pinned across the island like stars. Only seven are lit green.

lines.text: SYSTEM (gold, enormous): [WORLD EVENT: THE HUNDRED GATES] [100 GATES · 100 DAYS] [REWARD: ???]

11.label: PANEL 2
11.text: Pak Chan on a video call from his tower, ODY on the other end in the Werigo office.

lines.text: Pak Liam said "He will do." Now do. One hundred gates. One hundred days.
Pak... we have seven.
Then you have ninety-three to go.

11.label: PANEL 3 · COMEDY
11.text: Pak Chan holds up a mockup: a gigantic green WEDISON backdrop, six metres tall, dwarfing a tiny shop. Title card: CH.11 · THE BACKDROP WAR

lines.text: And every gate gets THIS.
Pak, it's bigger than the shop.
Good.

11.label: PANEL 4
11.text: Morning at the Werigo base. ODY introduces CINTA, a rolled map under her arm. Sekar leans on her pink Athena, Dewa sits on his grey EdPower.

lines.text: Escort? Since when do I escort?
Since the Board pays for fuel. Oh wait. We don't use fuel.

11.label: PANEL 5 · VFX
11.text: Cinta kneels and lays her palm on the asphalt. Glowing green heat lines spread across the road, brightest in front of a warung.

lines.text: [CINTA · CLASS: SITE SEER] [SKILL: GROUND SENSE]
Riders stop where the coffee is. Put the gate where the coffee is.

11.label: PANEL 6 · VFX
11.text: The paper map on the table unfolds into a glowing fantasy map of Bali with seven regions like dungeons.

lines.text: [DUNGEONS UNLOCKED: DENPASAR · SEMINYAK · KUTA · CANGGU · UBUD · JIMBARAN · ULUWATU]

11.label: PANEL 7 · COMEDY
11.text: RION arrives, laptop open, dark circles under his eyes. On the screen, backdrop version twelve covers an entire street.

lines.text: Pak Chan sent version twelve. At 3am.
Is that a backdrop or a new island?

11.label: PANEL 8 · SEMINYAK
11.text: A stylish café owner loves the charger, then sees the backdrop mockup and faints backwards onto a daybed.

lines.text: [SITE LOST]

11.label: PANEL 9 · KUTA
11.text: A surf shop owner stands in front of his board rack.

lines.text: Your sign goes where? In front of my boards?
[SITE LOST]

11.label: PANEL 10 · ULUWATU, MINI BOSS
11.text: On a temple wall above the cliff, a big monkey wears Dewa's sunglasses and holds Cinta's measuring tape. Behind him, a troop of monkeys.

lines.text: [MINI BOSS: KING OF THE CLIFF]
Give. Them. Back.

11.label: PANEL 11
11.text: Sekar holds up a banana. The monkey king drops the sunglasses and the tape instantly.

lines.text: Rule one in Uluwatu. Always bring a banana.
[ITEMS RECOVERED]

11.label: PANEL 12 · UBUD
11.text: A homestay owner among rice terraces, holding a red envelope.

lines.text: A foreign company came yesterday. Double rent. A man in loafers.
[RIVAL DETECTED: TURNCOAT]

11.label: PANEL 13
11.text: Evening. The fantasy map again: seven dungeons, all marked with red crosses.

lines.text: [GATES SECURED: 0 / 93]
Seven dungeons. Zero loot.

11.label: PANEL 14
11.text: Cinta shows a photo on her tablet.

lines.text: Every landlord on this island answers to one man.

11.label: PANEL 15 · SPLASH
11.text: A grand open bale in Denpasar, drawn like a throne hall: landlords seated along both sides like lords of a court, carved pillars, incense. At the head, PAK NYOMAN, fanning himself.

lines.text: [PAK NYOMAN · LORD OF THE LANDLORDS' COUNCIL]
I like your chargers. A rider who charges, sits. A rider who sits, eats. A rider who eats pays my tenants.
But your boss's backdrop? It eats my tenants' shopfronts.

11.label: PANEL 17 · VFX
11.text: Yoko sweeps in, arms wide. Red envelopes rain from the air over the council.

lines.text: Double rent. Triple backdrop.
[TURNCOAT · SKILL: GOLD RAIN]

11.label: PANEL 18
11.text: Landlords catch envelopes. Some waver. Pak Nyoman does not move.

11.label: PANEL 19 · COMEDY
11.text: Pak Chan arrives with Pak Remy. Pak Chan points at Yoko.

lines.text: Our backdrop will be bigger than his.
(face in his palm) Pak...
And what price are you suggesting?
(Yoko sweats.)

11.label: PANEL 20 · VFX
11.text: Pak Nyoman snaps his fan shut. Red and gold light cracks across the hall.

lines.text: SYSTEM (red and gold, enormous): [WORLD EVENT UPDATE: THE BACKDROP WAR]
Seven days. Whoever wins my last corner wins the council.

11.label: PANEL 21
11.text: On the tablet: a crossroads in Canggu where every rider passes.

lines.text: The last corner belongs to Ibu Sari. No phone. No email. Nobody has found her house in ten years.

11.label: PART 5 · THE GANG NO MAP SHOWS
PANEL 22
11.text: Everyone's phone map shows the same thing: a patch of grey fog where the gang should be.

lines.text: [UNMAPPED AREA]

11.label: PANEL 23 · VFX
11.text: Komang grins. Glowing blue footprints appear on the ground and lead into a tiny gap between two walls.

lines.text: No map? Good. I don't use maps.
[PATHFINDER · HIDDEN ROUTE DETECTED]

11.label: PANEL 24 · COMEDY
11.text: The gang entrance is barely wider than a handlebar. Komang's Victory and Sekar's Athena slip in. Dewa's big EdPower stops at the mouth of the gang.

lines.text: My bike is too handsome for this gang. I'll guard the entrance.

11.label: PANEL 25 · MINI BOSS
11.text: Three Bali street dogs block the path, eyes glowing, growling.

lines.text: [MINI BOSS: THREE GUARDIANS OF THE GANG]
...Komang?

11.label: PANEL 26 · COMEDY
11.text: Komang crouches and speaks softly in Balinese. The three dogs roll over for belly rubs.

lines.text: Kenken, cicing? Tiang Komang.
[GUARDIANS: BEFRIENDED]

11.label: PANEL 27 · VFX
11.text: Deeper in, the gang becomes a labyrinth: floating lanterns, canang on every step, glowing blue footprints turning corners that should not exist.

lines.text: How do you know all this?
My father delivered gas here for twenty years. On foot.

11.label: PANEL 28
11.text: The end of the gang. A small house under a big frangipani. IBU SARI sits weaving canang. She doesn't look up.

lines.text: Ten years, nobody found this door. You came with a Pathfinder. Sit.
Everybody wants my corner. Nobody asks what my corner wants.
What does it want?
Come at six tomorrow. Look.

11.label: PANEL 30
11.text: 06:00. The Canggu crossroads at sunrise. Ibu Sari's warung and, next door, a small bakery with a big shop window. Riders stop for coffee and bread. Cinta's Ground Sense lights the whole corner gold.

lines.text: [SITE RANK: S]
Everyone stops here. Everyone.

11.label: PANEL 31 · VFX
11.text: Yoko arrives first with workers raising a giant red backdrop that covers the bakery window and the warung. The backdrop comes alive: a monstrous golem wall with glowing red eyes, its shadow swallowing the shops.

lines.text: [TURNCOAT · SUMMON: BACKDROP GOLEM]

11.label: PANEL 32
11.text: In the shadow, customers walk straight past the hidden warung. Ibu Sari's face turns to stone.

11.label: PANEL 33 · COMEDY
11.text: Pak Chan arrives with Rion carrying an even bigger green backdrop.

lines.text: Ours is bigger. Put it up.
(hand up) Pak. Trust me. Once.

11.label: PANEL 34 · COMEDY
11.text: Close-up of Pak Chan's face, frozen.

lines.text: [PAK CHAN · TRUST: LOADING...]

11.label: PANEL 35 · VFX
11.text: ODY raises one hand. Green blueprint lines draw themselves in the air: one slim white pile at the kerb, a small WEDISON logo, every shopfront open.

lines.text: [OPERATOR · SKILL: BLUEPRINT] [SMALL BRAND · STRONG MACHINE · BLOCK NOBODY]

11.label: PANEL 36 · SPLASH, BATTLE
11.text: The green blueprint light strikes the red golem. The backdrop tears apart into falling red fabric. Sunlight pours back onto the warung and the bakery window.

lines.text: KRRRAAASH!

11.label: PANEL 37
11.text: Riders pull in, plug in at the new pile and walk into the warung and bakery. Arya plugs the gun into his olive Athena.

lines.text: Fifteen minutes. One coffee. Back on the road.

lines.text: [CLASS: WEDDING MAGE] [WEDDINGS CLEARED: 300+]

lines.text: Every tourist's first question in Bali: where we go?
Where we go? Where... we... go... We-ri-go.
[UNIQUE BRAND CREATED: WERIGO] [CREATOR: ODY]

lines.text: [PARALLEL QUESTS: 14]

12.text: Split panel. Left: a Singapore clock spinning like a jet turbine. Right: a Balinese clock melting slowly over a hammock under a coconut tree.

lines.text: Singapore time. Bali time.

Then I run on both clocks.
[SKILL LEARNED: DUAL CLOCK]

12.label: PANEL 8
12.text: ODY stands in front of three new faces at the Werigo base.

lines.text: Finally. My own party.
[HEREL · DEALMAKER] [WAYU · BRIDGEBUILDER] [IDY · SCRIBE (TRAINEE)]

12.label: PANEL 9
12.text: Herel shakes hands with a villa owner and turns to ODY with a fist pump.

lines.text: [HEREL · FIRST DEAL +1]

12.text: Idy, at the desk with a pen in each hand.

...Any pen.

12.text: ODY's phone, messages from Idy stacking up to the ceiling: "Pak, staple or clip?" "Pak, the printer is blinking." "Pak, can I open the window?"

lines.text: SYSTEM (red, repeating): [ODY · FOCUS -10] [-10] [-10] [-10]

12.text: ODY, head in his hands, a grey stamina bar over him.

lines.text: [OPERATOR · STAMINA 3%] [STATUS: BURNOUT]

12.text: A week later. Herel hands ODY a letter, eyes down.

lines.text: Another company offered me more. I'm sorry, Pak.

12.text: Wayu, helmet under his arm, waves goodbye at the gate.

lines.text: [WAYU HAS LEFT THE PARTY]

12.text: ODY and Idy, quietly.

lines.text: Idy... I think you need a place where someone can guide every step. I can't be that here.
...Okay, Pak. Thank you for asking me first.
[IDY HAS LEFT THE PARTY]

12.text: Night. Three empty desks. ODY alone. His party list shows one name.

lines.text: Everyone I train, I lose.

12.label: PANEL 17 · VFX
12.text: A video call with Jakarta. IBU INIA scrolls a glowing golden ledger of the guild's stipends. One line flashes past.

lines.text: Sorry, Pak Ody, wrong page. That's the old advisory stipend.
[STIPEND · YOKO (FORMER): GOLD TIER] [STIPEND · ODY: BRONZE TIER]

12.label: PANEL 18 · VFX
12.text: ODY's face. A crack runs across the air in front of him.

lines.text: The man who built nothing got gold. The man who built everything got bronze.

12.label: PANEL 19 · SPLASH
12.text: Night on an empty beach. ODY sits on his Athena. A huge System window glows over the dark sea, his finger hovering over YES.

lines.text: [SIGN OUT OF THE GUILD?] [YES] [NO]
For the first time, the Operator thought about logging out.

12.label: PANEL 20
12.text: Morning in a village. Families tie small offerings to fruit trees and tap the trunks. The grandmother (the Gatekeeper) taps a mango tree. ODY watches from the road.

lines.text: Nged... nged... nged.
Tumpek Wariga. Twenty-five days before Galungan, the Balinese bless the trees and ask them to bear fruit.
We don't ask the tree for fruit tomorrow, nak. We ask for Galungan. A rushed tree drops its fruit green.
And a tree that feels nobody values it?
Then somebody has to come and tap it. (She taps his chest.)

12.label: PANEL 22 · VFX
12.text: Golden leaves swirl around them.

lines.text: [GATEKEEPER · BLESSING: PATIENCE]

12.label: PANEL 23
12.text: ODY's phone rings. PAK CHAN, on video, in his tower at night.

lines.text: Ibu Inia told me what you saw.
Yoko's gold was my mistake. I paid for a mask. You are the face.

12.label: PANEL 24
12.text: Pak Chan lifts a small cup of tea to the camera.

lines.text: In Singapore we say the first cup of tea goes to the one who built the house. Werigo is your house, Ody. Whatever you build, I stand behind it.

12.label: PANEL 25 · VFX, callback
12.text: The purple loading bar from CH.11 fills: 27%... 64%... 100%.

lines.text: [PAK CHAN · TRUST 100%] [ODY · MORALE RESTORED]

12.label: PANEL 26 · VFX
12.text: ODY presses NO. The logout window shatters into green light.

lines.text: Not yet. I still have seventy gates to open.

12.label: PANEL 27 · SPLASH
12.text: Jakarta at sunrise, a glass tower among the skyscrapers.

lines.text: [DUNGEON: JAKARTA HQ]

12.label: PANEL 28
12.text: The boardroom. Pak Chan and Pak Remy on one side. On the other, PAK WRENCE with PAK RIMAN beside him, IBU ATEM with her folders and IBU INIA with her ledger.

lines.text: [PAK WRENCE · BOARD · STRATEGIST] [PAK RIMAN · GM · FORGEMASTER] [IBU ATEM · LEGAL · SEALKEEPER] [IBU INIA · FINANCE · TREASURER]

12.label: PANEL 29 · COMEDY
12.text: Pak Wrence checks his watch.

lines.text: We begin at 8:08. Eight is a lucky number.
(ODY pulls a small Balinese calendar out of his bag. Pak Wrence leans in, fascinated.)
You also have lucky days?
In Bali every day is good for something. The calendar tells you what.

12.label: PANEL 30 · VFX
12.text: ODY's pitch as a hologram: a driver paying a small coin each day, a progress bar under a Wedison filling up to OWNED.

lines.text: A driver pays a little every day, rides a Wedison from day one, and one day the bike is his.
What price are you suggesting?
Less than they spend on petrol.
(Pak Remy almost smiles. Pak Chan notices.)

12.label: PANEL 32 · VFX
12.text: A vault of golden light behind Ibu Inia.

lines.text: Every rupiah that leaves this company passes my desk. Show me the first hundred riders.
[TREASURER · APPRAISING...]
Units, I can make. Tell me which model and how many.

12.label: PANEL 34 · SPLASH, VFX
12.text: Pak Riman's vision: the Wedison factory drawn as a fantasy forge, sparks and blue light, rows of Athena, Victory, EdPower and Bees Pro rolling off the line.

lines.text: [FORGEMASTER · PRODUCTION LINE ONLINE]

12.label: PANEL 35 · PRODUCT
12.text: Pak Riman sets two blue water gallons on the flat footboard of a Bees Pro. They fit perfectly.

lines.text: For drivers with a side job: the Bees Pro. Two gallons at your feet. Boxes, crates, anything.

12.label: PANEL 36
12.text: IBU ATEM stands up, folders glowing with red seals.

lines.text: Stop. Nothing launches in Bali until the contracts and the local permits are done. Done, not "almost".
Bali doesn't wait, Bu. The drivers need it now.

12.label: PANEL 37 · VFX, COMEDY
12.text: Two System windows clash across the table: [LAW: ALL SEALS FIRST] vs [OPERATOR: RIDERS FIRST]. Sparks fly. Pak Chan and Pak Wrence turn their heads left and right like spectators at a tennis match.

12.label: PANEL 38 · FLASHBACK
12.text: The first weeks of Wedison Bali. Ibu Atem on the phone in Jakarta, papers everywhere.

lines.text: Pak Ody, I can't get one stamp in Bali. Can you help?
(ODY sits in a village office with the perbekel and the bendesa adat, a canang and a stack of papers on the mat between them.)
Jakarta sent the papers. Bali needed a person.

12.label: PANEL 39
12.text: Back in the boardroom.

lines.text: Remember our first permit? You sent the law. I brought the canang. We need both again.
...You sat three hours with the bendesa. I remember.

12.label: PANEL 40 · VFX
12.text: Ibu Atem slides one folder across the table. The two windows merge into one.

lines.text: Contracts first. In Bali we go through the desa adat and the banjar together. You bring the canang, I bring the seals.
And after Bali, Surabaya. I'm already packing.
[ALLIANCE FORMED: SEALKEEPER + OPERATOR]

12.label: PANEL 41
12.text: Pak Wrence turns his jade beads, speaking to Pak Chan.

lines.text: Your operator argues like a lawyer and prays like a priest.
That's why I keep him.
Launch on the eighth.
I asked our pemangku. The eighth is a good day to begin.
(A golden Chinese eight and a Balinese calendar glyph meet in the air and lock together.)
[AUSPICIOUS DAY: CONFIRMED BY BOTH CALENDARS] [QUEST APPROVED: RENT TO OWN]

12.label: PANEL 43 · SPLASH
12.text: The eighth. The ojol base under the banyan tree. A pemangku sprinkles tirta over a row of new Wedison bikes (Athena, Victory, Bees Pro), a canang on every seat. Drivers in a line. The gate by the market glows green.

12.label: PANEL 44 · PRODUCT
12.text: Made signs first. His wife stands beside a Bees Pro with two blue gallons on its footboard.

lines.text: My wife runs a galon refill shop. Two gallons at her feet. No petrol.
[MADE · RENT TO OWN · DAY 1]

12.label: PANEL 45 · COMEDY
12.text: Komang tries to squeeze a third gallon onto the Bees Pro. It rolls off.

lines.text: Three! ...No. Two. Two is the number.

12.label: PANEL 46
12.text: ODY hands a key to the young driver from CH.11.

lines.text: Day one. It's already yours in every way that matters.
Then I'll ride it like it's mine, Pak.
[QUEST COMPLETE: RENT TO OWN]

12.label: PANEL 47 · SPLASH, VFX
12.text: The drivers ride out from under the banyan into the city, green light trails behind every bike. A huge window opens over Denpasar.

lines.text: SYSTEM (green, enormous): [OPERATOR · LEVEL UP] [TITLE UNLOCKED: FOUNDER OF WERIGO]

12.label: PANEL 48
12.text: Later, alone at the base, ODY writes on a napkin again: a party list with empty slots.

lines.text: Next time I build a party that stays.
[PARTY SLOTS OPEN: 4]

12.label: PANEL 49 · CLIFFHANGER
12.text: The Werigo WhatsApp lights up. A new message from a long-stay guest, DENISA: "Hi! Can I rent two bikes for a month? And if I love them... can I buy one?"

lines.text: [NEW QUEST: THE NOMAD]

13.text: A glowing world map floats in the dark, covered in thirty pins of light. In the middle, DENISA with one backpack, eyes closed.

lines.text: [PLAYER: DENISA · CLASS: WANDERER] [COUNTRIES CLEARED: 30]
SYSTEM (red, small): [CURSE: NOMAD'S CURSE · NEVER STAY MORE THAN 90 DAYS]

lines.text: [INVENTORY: 7 ITEMS · FURNITURE: 0 · REGRETS: 0]

13.label: PANEL 3
13.text: She lands in Bali at night. The heat hits her. Frangipani, incense, scooters. Title card: CH.13 · THE NOMAD

lines.text: Country thirty-one. Three months. Then I go.
[DAYS REMAINING: 90]

13.label: PANEL 4
13.text: The Werigo base at night. ODY reads Denisa's WhatsApp from CH.12 again and grins.

lines.text: Two bikes, one month, and she's already asking about buying.
Nobody asks that on day one.
[HIDDEN QUEST DETECTED: THE SETTLER]

13.label: PANEL 5
13.text: Morning in Pererenan. Arya and Komang ride up to a small coliving villa: Arya on his olive Athena, Komang leading a white Wedison Victory and a red Bees Pro.

lines.text: A month's rental. Delivery included.

13.label: PANEL 6 · PRODUCT
13.text: The Werigo handover at the gate. Two clean helmets, a phone holder already fixed on the handlebar. Arya shows her the battery on the display.

lines.text: Over eighty percent. At night you plug it in at home, like your phone.
I've never had anything to plug in at home.

13.label: PANEL 7 · VFX
13.text: A gold window opens over her, the same kind Chloe got in CH.5.

lines.text: [NOMAD PASS · 30 DAYS]

13.label: PANEL 8 · PRODUCT, COMEDY
13.text: Denisa loads two crates of cold brew bottles onto the Bees Pro's flat footboard. They fit perfectly.

lines.text: It fits two gallons too!
It fits twenty-four bottles. That's better than gallons.
...Nothing is better than gallons.
The Victory is for me. The Bees Pro is for the business. Coworking spaces pay well for cold brew at 3pm.
[DENISA · SIDE QUEST: COLD BREW ROUTE]

13.label: PANEL 10 · MONTAGE
13.text: DAY 2: Denisa rides the white Victory along the Canggu coast at sunrise, hair flying, no helmet off, grinning.

13.label: PANEL 11 · MONTAGE
13.text: DAY 6: A coworking space. She hands out cold brew from the Bees Pro crates.

lines.text: [COLD BREW ROUTE · LEVEL 2]

13.label: PANEL 12 · MONTAGE, PRODUCT
13.text: DAY 9: She plugs the Victory into a Wedison SuperCharge pile outside a café while she answers emails with a coffee.

lines.text: Fifteen minutes. One email. Full enough to ride home.

13.label: PANEL 13 · MONTAGE, COMEDY
13.text: DAY 12: Komang teaches her Balinese words at a warung.

lines.text: "Suksma" is thank you.
Suksma!
And "Komang ganteng" means... also thank you.
(Arya, drinking kopi, chokes.)

13.label: PANEL 14
13.text: DAY 14: Her neighbour, the old woman next door, puts a small offering at the villa gate and a second one at Denisa's gate.

lines.text: Tonight is Kajeng Kliwon. Come home before midnight, nak.

13.label: PANEL 15
13.text: 23:40. Denisa is still at a sunset party in Canggu, laughing, phone buzzing with orders.

lines.text: She did not come home before midnight.

13.label: PANEL 16
13.text: 00:10. She rides home alone on the white Victory through dark rice fields. No engine sound at all. Only crickets.

13.label: PANEL 17 · HORROR
13.text: In the rice fields, small floating lights appear, one by one, drifting toward the road. No sound.

lines.text: Fireflies. They're fireflies. Fireflies don't... float that high.

13.label: PANEL 18 · HORROR
13.text: She stops. The lights hang in the air around her. Somewhere far away, a slow gamelan. Her phone rings: KOMANG.

lines.text: Where are you?! Don't stop! Don't look at the lights!
I already stopped. And I'm already looking.

13.label: PANEL 19 · COMEDY
13.text: Split: Komang at home under his blanket, only his eyes showing, phone glowing.

lines.text: Say "nunas lugra". Say it!
Noonas... loogra?

13.label: PANEL 20 · VFX
13.text: At the crossroads there is a small offering on the ground, the same kind her neighbour made. Denisa takes the little canang her neighbour tucked into her bag that afternoon and places it beside the other one, hands together, head bowed.

lines.text: Nunas lugra. I'm just passing. I'm... a guest.

13.label: PANEL 21 · VFX
13.text: The lights circle her once, slowly, then drift back into the rice fields and fade. The silent Victory glides on.

lines.text: SYSTEM (old gold, faint): [THE ISLAND IS WATCHING]

13.label: PANEL 22
13.text: At her gate, the neighbour is waiting in the dark with a lamp.

lines.text: Late.
I said nunas lugra.
(smiling) Then they know your name now.

13.label: PANEL 23
13.text: Video call. ODY in Bali, Pak Chan and Pak Remy in Singapore.

lines.text: Every renter is a future owner. Denisa asked on day one. Give me a program: rent first, buy later.

13.label: PANEL 24 · VFX
13.text: Pak Remy's APPRAISAL: numbers orbit a small figure of Denisa on a bike.

lines.text: One nomad is a story, not a funnel.
Then let me show you the funnel.

13.label: PANEL 25 · COMEDY
13.text: Pak Remy places a small orange on his desk, next to a tiny cup of tea, very seriously.

lines.text: But nothing is signed this month.
...Why is there an orange?
It's the seventh month. Hungry Ghost Month. Nobody buys a new vehicle now. Not in Singapore.

13.label: PANEL 26 · SPLASH, FANTASY
13.text: Split page. Left: a Singapore street at night, joss paper burning in metal bins, oranges and incense, an empty front row of red chairs before a getai stage "for the guests you can't see". Right: a Bali gate on Kajeng Kliwon, canang on the ground, incense smoke. Faint spirit shapes in both halves.

lines.text: Two islands. Same rule: feed the unseen before you ask for anything.

13.label: PANEL 27 · COMEDY
13.text: Night at the Werigo base. Komang, fixing a helmet, starts whistling. On the laptop, Pak Chan and Pak Remy lean into the camera at the same time.

lines.text: PAK CHAN & PAK REMY: DON'T WHISTLE AT NIGHT!
...In Bali also, actually.
(Komang stops whistling.)
Fine. The gates of the underworld close at the end of the month. If your nomad still wants to buy then, we make it a program.
She rents until then. That's exactly the point.

13.label: PANEL 29
13.text: Day 29 of her pass. Denisa's laptop: a flight to another country, already booked. Her System window turns red.

lines.text: [NOMAD'S CURSE · DAY 89 OF 90] [NEXT COUNTRY?]

13.label: PANEL 30
13.text: She stares at the white Victory parked in her garden, charging cable plugged in for the night.

lines.text: I've never been sad to give something back before.

13.label: PANEL 31
13.text: The Werigo base. A postcard arrives from Melbourne: a hand-drawn yellow Athena on a Bali road, signed "Chloe". Arya reads it aloud.

lines.text: "March is booked. Save the yellow one. Jake says hi."

13.label: PANEL 32
13.text: Arya shows the postcard to Denisa at the base.

lines.text: She's coming back?
Many come back. Some never leave.
Everybody says Bali keeps you or spits you out.

13.label: PANEL 33
13.text: The grandmother (the Gatekeeper), passing with canang, stops.

lines.text: The island doesn't keep anyone, nak. People decide to stay. The island only notices.
...How do I know it noticed me?
It sent you lights on Kajeng Kliwon and let you go home. That's noticing.

13.label: PANEL 34 · SPLASH, VFX
13.text: Denisa opens her laptop and cancels the flight. Her red curse window cracks, then shatters into gold.

lines.text: [NOMAD'S CURSE: BROKEN] [CLASS CHANGE: WANDERER → SETTLER]
I just cancelled a flight for a scooter.
For an electric scooter. Big difference.

13.label: PANEL 36 · FANTASY
13.text: Singapore, the last night of the seventh month. Joss paper embers rise, and a huge ghostly gate in the sky slowly closes.

lines.text: [HUNGRY GHOST MONTH · ENDED]

13.label: PANEL 37 · COMEDY
13.text: Pak Remy removes the orange from his desk and eats it.

lines.text: Now we can sign.

13.label: PANEL 38 · SPLASH
13.text: Morning at the Wedison showroom in Denpasar: glass front, a row of Wedison bikes inside, the WEDISON sign above. Denisa rides up on the white Victory with Arya and Komang behind her.

lines.text: [LOCATION: WEDISON SHOWROOM · DENPASAR]

13.label: PANEL 39 · PRODUCT
13.text: Inside, ODY and Denisa at a desk with papers, the white Victory beside them.

lines.text: I rented it to find out if I'd stay. Now I know. I want to own this one.
Then from today, it's yours.

13.label: PANEL 40 · COMEDY
13.text: Pak Remy on a tablet video call propped on the desk.

lines.text: What price are you suggesting?
Nothing. She sold it to herself.
...Then she is our first data point.

13.label: PANEL 41 · VFX
13.text: A blue funnel of light: many small rental keys at the top, one golden key at the bottom landing in Denisa's hand.

lines.text: [RENTER → OWNER: 1] [FUNNEL CONFIRMED] [QUEST COMPLETE: THE SETTLER]
And the Bees Pro stays a rental. The business rents. I own.
Monthly again?
Monthly forever. The cold brew doesn't carry itself.

13.label: PANEL 43 · COMEDY
13.text: Komang holds out his hand to Denisa.

lines.text: Payment for the Balinese lessons: one free cold brew a day.
Suksma, Komang ganteng.
(Komang freezes. Arya laughs so hard he has to sit down.)

13.label: PANEL 44 · SPLASH, VFX
13.text: Sunset. Denisa rides the white Victory along the coast, the red Bees Pro following with Arya. Her world map glows in the sky: thirty pins, and on Bali a small golden house.

lines.text: [INVENTORY: 8 ITEMS · FURNITURE: 0 · WEDISON: 1]

13.label: PANEL 45
13.text: Back at the villa, she writes a new cactus tag and plants a frangipani cutting by her gate. Her neighbour nods.

lines.text: This one will stay.

13.label: PANEL 46
13.text: The Werigo base. Putu drags in a half-finished ogoh-ogoh head, grinning. Behind him the calendar shows a red circle.

lines.text: Nyepi is coming. The whole island turns off for a day.

13.label: PANEL 47 · VFX, COMEDY
13.text: On a video call, Pak Chan's face.

lines.text: What do you mean the airport closes?
Everything closes, Pak. No lights. No roads. No work. For twenty-four hours.
(Pak Chan's glasses crack.)
SYSTEM (grey, glitching): [WORLD EVENT INCOMING: THE DAY OF SILENCE]

13.text: To be continued... NEXT CHAPTER: CH.14 · NYEPI. Did Bali keep you, or did it let you go? Tell us in the comments.
